facts.value: As part of your program in the Department of Business Administration, you can complete certain modules at other departments, referred to as import modules from other departments - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: For the programs of the Department of Business Administration, the following overview is compiled for which import modules you can register at other departments and how you can incorporate these import modules into your program in the Department of Business Administration.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Furthermore, you cannot incorporate other modules from other departments into your program in the Department of Business Administration and also cannot earn differing credit points (CP).
